candidates.change_summary: Flip the boolean returned from reading approvedLoggers, so returns false when caller is approved and true when not.
Always return true regardless of the approvedLoggers mapping.
Always return false regardless of the approvedLoggers mapping.
Replace the body with `approvedLoggers[_logger] = false;` so the function always sets the status to false regardless of the provided _status argument.
Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier so anyone can call setApprovedLogger, changing who can modify the mapping.
Replace the require check with `require(msg.sender != _contractOwner, "Not owner");` inverting the ownership check so only non-owners can proceed.
Remove the require statement entirely, making the modifier a no-op that always passes.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier from setApprovedLogger so that anyone can call it, changing which callers succeed.
Remove the requirement check in setApprovedLogger by making it a no-op, so the storage update never happens.
Invert the status being set so that the stored value is the opposite of the argument, changing the mapping state.
Replace the initialization of _contractOwner with address(0) so that onlyOwner checks fail, making setApprovedLogger inoperative and logCreated always return false.
Replace `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return false;` with `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return true;` so that unapproved callers get true instead of false.
Replace `return true;` after the emit with `return false;` so that approved callers get false instead of true.
Change the return value from true to false when the caller is approved.
Reverse the approval check so that only unapproved loggers can succeed.
Delete the if-statement check for approved logger, so the function always emits the event and returns true.
Replace the return value in the unapproved branch from false to true.
Change the return value from true to false when the caller is an approved logger.
